verdict.rationale: Amplitude exposes broad APIs (HTTP V2 ingestion, Dashboard REST API for chart data, Experiment APIs for flags/experiments, Cohort APIs, OpenAPI spec) letting many core actions be scripted outside the UI. However, several UI-only capabilities (visual A/B test editor, session replay viewing/analysis, in-product guides/surveys authoring, AI chat 'ask in plain language' interface) are not shown to have full API equivalents in the evidence. Missing for 10: API parity for visual editor/session replay/guides authoring, independent confirmation of complete UI-API feature parity, and evidence the OpenAPI spec covers all UI workflows.
